name: html-generator-kit
description: Turns a validated spec-dev-kit spec into a clickable Alpine.js multi-page HTML prototype (CDN-free for styling and scripting — Alpine.js is vendored; only Google Fonts loads from a CDN). A provided theme, brand, style guide, mockup, or layout is binding; ui-ux-pro-max supplies the design direction only when none is provided. Headless-browser verified before the skill-owned review gate.
